title: Concentration and Particle Density
text: Concentration measures how many particles of solute are in a given volume. Higher concentration = more particles per dm$$^3$$.

title: More Particles, More Collisions
text: With more HCl particles in the same volume, there is a higher probability of collisions between H$$^+$$ ions and zinc atoms. More collisions per second means a faster reaction.

title: Mathematical Relationship
text: For most reactions, doubling the concentration approximately doubles the collision frequency, which approximately doubles the reaction rate.
